R67.cause: harness preparation pinned the 0.2.0 package-lock.json hash in dependency-pins.json; harness defect, no product evidence

R68.observation: receiver-1 and receiver-2 switch from low to high about 150 s in and then received no high-quality segment from a peer; every high transfer was declined as projected-late or missed its deadline
R68.diagnosis: Product mechanism on a one-segment margin, tipped over by origin media fetches 1.5 to 2 times slower than in R66 (cause not determined). The projection uses the viewer's own origin median as the holder wait, with no back-off; about 670 KB high-quality segments over the relay are abandoned at the deadline; a spent neighbour replacement resets only on a verified high-quality segment. High confidence on mechanism, low on trigger.
